soru: Karmaşık bellek erişim örüntülerini tahmin eden akıllı veri önceden getirme (prefetching) teknikleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Karmaşık bellek erişim örüntülerini tahmin eden akıllı veri önceden getirme (prefetching) teknikleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-05-08. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Memory Access Patterns
calismalar.gerekce: This ICML 2018 paper framed prefetching as a sequence-prediction problem, showed that LSTM models can predict memory accesses, and started the neural prefetching line of research.

calismalar.baslik: A Hierarchical Neural Model of Data Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: Voyager splits addresses into page and offset parts in a hierarchical neural model, so it learns both address and delta correlations and handles irregular access patterns well.

calismalar.baslik: Pythia: A Customizable Hardware Prefetching Framework Using Online Reinforcement Learning
calismalar.gerekce: Pythia is a practical online reinforcement-learning prefetcher that adapts to memory bandwidth, and it is now a standard baseline in the field.

calismalar.baslik: Semantic locality and context-based prefetching using reinforcement learning
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced the idea of semantic locality and was the first context-based prefetcher to use reinforcement learning.

calismalar.baslik: Linearizing irregular memory accesses for improved correlated prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: The Irregular Stream Buffer (ISB) maps irregular, PC-localized address streams into a structural address space, a key step for temporal prefetching.

calismalar.baslik: Temporal Prefetching Without the Off-Chip Metadata
calismalar.gerekce: Triage keeps temporal-prefetcher metadata in part of the last-level cache, which made practical on-chip temporal prefetching possible.

calismalar.baslik: Triangel: A High-Performance, Accurate, Timely On-Chip Temporal Prefetcher
calismalar.gerekce: It extends Triage with sampling-based accuracy and timeliness mechanisms and set the state of the art for on-chip temporal prefetching.

calismalar.baslik: Perceptron-based prefetch filtering
calismalar.gerekce: A perceptron filter removes inaccurate prefetches so the underlying prefetcher can run more aggressively, a key example of lightweight ML in hardware.

calismalar.baslik: Path confidence based lookahead prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: The Signature Path Prefetcher (SPP) uses confidence-driven lookahead over delta signatures and is a basic reference point for complex delta patterns.

calismalar.baslik: Best-offset hardware prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: The DPC-2 winning BOP learns the best offset from timeliness and is the most common rule-based baseline for ML prefetchers.

calismalar.baslik: Fine-Grained Address Segmentation for Attention-Based Variable-Degree Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: TransFetch combines attention-based models with address segmentation and delta-bitmap outputs to give variable-degree prefetching.

calismalar.baslik: Attention, Distillation, and Tabularization: Towards Practical Neural Network-Based Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: DART uses distillation and table lookups to tackle the inference-latency and cost barrier of neural prefetchers.

calismalar.baslik: Bingo Spatial Data Prefetcher
calismalar.gerekce: It improved spatial footprint prediction by correlating footprints with multiple events and is a strong spatial baseline.

calismalar.baslik: Spatial Memory Streaming
calismalar.gerekce: SMS is the foundational work that learns spatial access patterns within code-correlated regions.

calismalar.baslik: Data Cache Prefetching Using a Global History Buffer
calismalar.gerekce: The GHB structure gave a general framework for storing correlation and delta history and shaped later prefetcher designs.

calismalar.baslik: Prefetching using Markov predictors
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced Markov-model-based correlation prefetching and is the conceptual starting point for probabilistic access prediction.

calismalar.baslik: Hermes: Accelerating Long-Latency Load Requests via Perceptron-Based Off-Chip Load Prediction
calismalar.gerekce: It uses perceptron-based off-chip load prediction to complement prefetching and showed that prefetchers miss many off-chip loads.

calismalar.baslik: Phases, Modalities, Spatial and Temporal Locality: Domain Specific ML Prefetcher for Accelerating Graph Analytics
calismalar.gerekce: MPGraph uses phase detection and phase-specific models to target the complex access patterns of graph analytics.

calismalar.baslik: Efficient metadata management for irregular data prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: MISB addresses metadata traffic and storage cost, a central problem in temporal prefetching.

calismalar.baslik: Bouquet of Instruction Pointers: Instruction Pointer Classifier-based Spatial Hardware Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: IPCP is the DPC-3 winning design that classifies instruction pointers by access pattern to get high performance from little storage.

calismalar.baslik: Berti: an Accurate Local-Delta Data Prefetcher
calismalar.gerekce: It learns timely local deltas per instruction at high accuracy and is a strong recent L1D baseline.

calismalar.baslik: Classifying Memory Access Patterns for Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: It systematically classifies memory access patterns in real applications and analyzes where prefetchers fall short.

calismalar.baslik: ReSemble: Reinforced Ensemble Framework for Data Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: It uses reinforcement learning to coordinate several prefetchers dynamically and set the direction for ensemble approaches on mixed patterns.

calismalar.baslik: Feedback Directed Prefetching: Improving the Performance and Bandwidth-Efficiency of Hardware Prefetchers
calismalar.gerekce: It tunes prefetch aggressiveness from accuracy, timeliness and pollution feedback, which laid the groundwork for adaptive control.

calismalar.baslik: A Two Level Neural Approach Combining Off-Chip Prediction with Adaptive Prefetch Filtering
calismalar.gerekce: TLP coordinates off-chip prediction and prefetch filtering with neural perceptrons and addresses the problem of prefetchers and predictors interacting.

calismalar.baslik: Gaze into the Pattern: Characterizing Spatial Patterns with Internal Temporal Correlations for Hardware Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: It characterizes spatial patterns through the temporal order of accesses inside a footprint and improves on recent spatial prefetchers such as PMP and vBerti.

calismalar.baslik: Profile-Guided Temporal Prefetching
calismalar.gerekce: Prophet uses hardware-software co-design and profile hints to manage temporal-prefetching metadata and clearly beats Triangel.

calismalar.baslik: Domino Temporal Data Prefetcher
calismalar.gerekce: It looks up temporal streams using the last one or two misses together, which improves both accuracy and coverage of temporal correlation.

calismalar.baslik: Practical off-chip meta-data for temporal memory streaming
calismalar.gerekce: STMS made temporal streaming practical with off-chip metadata and is the classic reference for later temporal prefetchers.

calismalar.baslik: A neural network memory prefetcher using semantic locality
calismalar.gerekce: It is an early hardware neural prefetcher that links program context to memory access patterns through a neural network.
